title: Balanced ordinary scalar association at the coefficient unit and root module
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ with $\ell$ invertible, and $f:X\to Y$. Fix normalized Chern data $c_Y,c_X$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern], geometric tower data $b,g$ [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], and normalized coefficient and line comparisons $\theta_0,\theta_1$ [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal, def-sp-tower-class-pullback]. Fix integral inverse-image data $d$ [def-sp-tower-chern-pullback-intermediate] such that at each level the middle component of its Kummer morphism equals $\operatorname{unitsPull}(f)$ [lem-sp-tower-integral-class-pullback]. Write $E_T=c_T.\mathrm{scalar.model.E}$. Given arrows $e_T:E_T(R_T)\to A_T$ whose ordinary scalar-adjunction transposes are $\operatorname{scalarGenerator}_T$ [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients], there is a natural isomorphism $\alpha:E_Yg^*\simeq d^*E_X$ such that $\alpha_{R_Y}\,E_X(d.\mathrm{unitIso.hom})\,e_X=g^*(e_Y)\,\theta_0.\mathrm{iso.hom}$ and $\alpha_{c_Y.\mathrm{rootModule}}\,E_X(d.\mathrm{rootIso.hom})=\theta_1.\mathrm{iso.hom}$. Compositions are written left to right. All functors and arrows in the conclusion are in the ordinary abelian categories of module systems. There is no derived counit equation and no condition on pullback of complexes.

proof.text: Construct the normalized restriction/scalar adjunction a and the section-identity comparison chi of forgotten direct images. The composite source scalar/geometric adjunction has the same right adjoint. Its unique left-adjoint comparison with a defines alpha.

For any component t, the source Hom equivalence sends alpha followed by t to the target Hom equivalence of t, by the unit equation for uniqueness of left adjoints and ordinary adjunction naturality. The recorded Forget functor is faithful: apply its morphism equation at every level and chart to an equality of forgotten maps.

Transpose the coefficient equation, apply the faithful Forget functor and postcompose with chi. The normalization of a and the unit abelian-transpose calculation identify the two sides. Cancel chi and the two faithful/injective maps. Repeat with the root abelian-transpose calculation. This proves both original endpoint equations for the same natural isomorphism alpha.

theorem ordinaryScalarAssociation_exists
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (cY : Chern l E Y) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (nY : cY.Normalized l E) (nX : cX.Normalized l E)
    (θ₀ : CoefficientPullback l E b f g) (θ₁ : LinePullback l E f g cY cX)
    (d : IntegralCoefficientPullback l E f cY cX)
    (hk : ∀ n : ℕ, d.kummer.τ₂.app (Opposite.op n) =
      (unitsPull f).app (Opposite.op n))
    (eY : cY.scalar.model.E.obj (coefficient Y (Rrings l Y)) ⟶
      coefficient Y (Arings l E Y))
    (eX : cX.scalar.model.E.obj (coefficient X (Rrings l X)) ⟶
      coefficient X (Arings l E X))
    (heY : (cY.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _) eY = scalarGenerator l E Y)
    (heX : (cX.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _) eX = scalarGenerator l E X) :
    ∃ α : cY.scalar.model.E ⋙ g.pull ≅ d.pull ⋙ cX.scalar.model.E,
      α.hom.app (coefficient Y (Rrings l Y)) ≫ cX.scalar.model.E.map d.unitIso.hom ≫ eX =
        g.pull.map eY ≫ θ₀.iso.hom ∧
      α.hom.app cY.rootModule ≫ cX.scalar.model.E.map d.rootIso.hom = θ₁.iso.hom
